name: ndiag-alignment-server
description: MCP server for sequence alignment and phylogenetic analysis
author: Neglected Diagnostics MCP Team

tools.name: align_sequences
tools.description: Align sequences using MAFFT, MUSCLE, Clustal Omega, or gget_muscle

tools.name: process_alignment
tools.description: Process and clean alignment using CIAlign with gap removal and quality assessment

tools.name: build_phylogeny
tools.description: Build phylogenetic tree using NJ, ML, or MP methods

tools.name: calculate_distances
tools.description: Calculate pairwise distance matrix from alignment

tools.name: align_and_analyze
tools.description: Complete pipeline: align, process, and optionally build phylogeny
